name: ShadowFi SDF unauthenticated burn(address,uint256)
summary: ShadowFi's SDF token exposed burn(address account, uint256 amount) with no access, allowance or msg.sender check, moving any holder's SDF to the dead address. The attacker bought a little SDF, burned all but one wei of the PancakeSwap SDF/WBNB pair's SDF, synced the pair and swapped its SDF back for nearly all of the pair's WBNB.
notes: The owner later exempted the pair from the tx limit and lowered the limit to 150,000 SDF; the burn passed via that exemption, but splitting it into limit-sized burns works without it, so it is not a reset. Other owner calls were fee, swap-back and trading settings.

Pre-anchor burns were the owner's own; a later copycat burned the pair again and swapped out 0.003 WBNB of refilled liquidity. The burned SDF is not valued separately, as its only market was this pair.
